name: Blockyard Paper
author: accounts@playblockyard.com
description: Reviewed Minecraft installer with AuthMe, ViaVersion and PacketEvents. Minecraft and offline accounts supported with password protection and whitelist enabled. EULA acceptance is separate.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
rm -f .blockyard-install.json
USER_AGENT='Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)'
BASE="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$BASE" -o version.json
if [ "$BUILD_NUMBER" = latest ]; then BUILD_NUMBER=$(jq -er '.builds[0]' version.json); fi
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$BASE/builds/$BUILD_NUMBER" -o build.json
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].url' build.json)
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --user-agent "$USER_AGENT" "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o server.jar.part
jar tf server.jar.part >/dev/null
mv server.jar.part server.jar
rm version.json build.json
bash /opt/blockyard/default-plugins/install.sh "$MINECRAFT_VERSION"
printf '{"software":"PAPER","minecraft_version":"%s","loader_version":"%s"}\n' "$MINECRAFT_VERSION" "$BUILD_NUMBER" > .blockyard-install.json.tmp
mv .blockyard-install.json.tmp .blockyard-install.json

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Operator-approved Minecraft version. Unsupported versions fail installation.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Paper build for the approved Minecraft release. latest selects the newest published build for that exact release.
